question: Which deities are to be worshipped on the left and right sides and by what means?
premises: Worship is prescribed on the left and right sides.
The deities to be worshipped are Bhū and Śrī.
Each is worshipped with her own mantra.
inference: Bhū and Śrī are to be worshipped on the left and right sides respectively, each with her own mantra.
plain_english: On the left and right sides, Bhū and Śrī are to be worshipped, each with her own mantra.
